resources.string: Create a pairing code on the gateway web page, then enter its address and code below.
Gateway connected. Waiting for CLI / MCP requests
Pairing expired or revoked. Pair the gateway again
Copy the config to your MCP client on the computer to connect.
Disconnect this phone from the gateway. An internet connection is required. The phone access token stays unchanged.
Couldn’t finish. Check the gateway address, internet connection and pairing code. If unpairing failed, access is off; retry or revoke the phone on the gateway.
Remote access is enabled. Open Mika to check the gateway connection.
Update Mika and the gateway to matching versions
Save the access token to a file on your computer, then run the connection command above.
The gateway forwards the CLI and MCP requests normally sent over Wi-Fi / LAN to your phone for remote access. Deploy it on your own public server before pairing.
Allow wake and unlock through the gateway
Off by default. Also needs “Allow remote wake and unlock” on this page. When both are on, anyone with the access token can wake and unlock this phone over the internet.
